blocks.label: Overview
bullets: With Supercritical Extracts of Neem Leaf and Neem Bark
paragraphs: If you want your teeth to gleam, brush with Neem!™

Neem has been traditionally used in Ayurveda for oral health care. Commonly known in India as the Toothbrush Tree, Neem twigs are frequently used to clean the teeth. Modern science continues to study the ancient wisdom of using Neem.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Adults and children age 7 and older, use a 1-inch strip of paste. For children ages 2-7, use a pea-sized amount of paste. For children under 2 years of age, consult with a doctor or dentist. Instruct your child in good brushing and rinsing habits. For best results, brush teeth twice a day, after each meal, or as directed by your dentist, and floss daily.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Calcium carbonate, sorbitol, aqua (water), glycerin, silica, sodium lauroyl glutamate, xylitol, xanthan gum, cyamopsis tetragonoloba (guar) gum, vitis vinifera (grape) seed oil, glycyrrhiza glabra (licorice) root*, foeniculum vulgare (fennel)*, eugenia caryophyllus (clove) bud oil*, azadirachta indica (neem) leaf*, azadirachta indica (neem) bark*, mentha piperita (peppermint) oil, potassium sorbate, mentha viridis (spearmint) oil, ascorbic acid.
